eu.heading: Get the Vexl app
eu.iphone.subtitle: 3 easy steps – please read instructions first
eu.iphone.altStore.title: Get AltStore Pal
eu.iphone.altStore.text: AltStore is an alternative app platform that lets you securely download and update our app outside the App Store — helping you take back your freedom to install the apps you want. **Return here after downloading.**
eu.iphone.altStore.mobileText: Return to this page once the download is complete. Then follow step 2.
eu.iphone.freedomStore.title: Add Freedom Store
eu.iphone.freedomStore.text: Freedom Store lets you install apps Apple won’t. Add it as a source in AltStore to take back control of your device and access Bitcoin and freedom tech apps without App Store gatekeepers. **Tap the button on the right and install Vexl from there.**
eu.iphone.freedomStore.mobileText: Add Freedom Store in AltStore Pal to access freedom tech apps. Install Vexl from there.
eu.iphone.install.title: Install Vexl
eu.iphone.install.text: Install Vexl from the Freedom Store. That feeling? It’s freedom — and it’s yours again.
eu.iphone.install.mobileText: Install Vexl from Freedom Store and start trading.
